title: 第七章撑死胆大的第八章 家贫人情能欠就欠
lines: 依然是林砚穿越来的那破败院子。
那位在茶肆现身的武者大人，穿着华服坐在上首座椅上。
若是此刻理智尚在之人，就会发现不对劲之处。
堂堂武者，岂会出现在这破败院落。
不过此时的林砚，是扮演一位被练武喜讯给砸中的少年，自然不会点破这些。
“大人，这是我特意从兰桂坊买来的糕点，还请大人笑纳。”
看到林砚打开纸包，赵传和张大海对视了一眼，眼神中流露出一缕不屑。
真是蠢得天真，几包糕点也好意思叫笑纳。
不过这般蠢，才好忽悠。
“有心了。”
赵传拿起一块糕点尝了一口。
“大人，味道如何？”
赵传愣住了，真是个愣头青，只有上位者或者长辈赐予晚辈糕点，才会这般询问糕点好不好吃，你个小辈好意思问？
不过赵传还是下意识的又品尝了一口，淡淡道：“不错。”
“大人，林砚他一心想要学武，上次得大人摸了根骨，这段时间一直用药汤调养身体气血，这次是想拜大人您为师的。”
一旁的张大海憋不住了，不想再看林砚耍活宝了，早点进入正事。
“是嘛，此事我有些印象，你且上前来，我再看下你的根骨。”
林砚闻言上前，赵传手掌在林砚身上似模似样的摸了一会，等松开口，却是叹了一口气：“气血比上次充足了不少，但离着练武还有些差距，难。”
“啊，怎么会这样？”
林砚面色变得着急，张大海见状也是连忙道：“大人，林砚他一片赤心，您看看是不是有什么办法？”
“方法倒也不是没有，有一种丹药名为炼血丹，只要服用后便能弥补气血上的不足，但此丹价格不低，一枚便要三十两。”
好家伙，这要的不只是自家的老宅，连现在自己和婶婶居住的宅子也要啊。
三十两一枚的丹药，加上先前自己欠下的汤药钱，足有五十多两了。
林砚一脸慌乱表情，一旁张大海咬咬牙：“林老弟有练武之姿，这笔钱我愿意替他出了，敢问大人……这炼血丹哪里有的售卖？”
“城中药铺便有。”
听着这两人在这里唱着双簧，林砚心底有些疑惑，去药铺买，城中药铺应该不至于配合这两人演戏吧。
“林老弟，你在这里稍等片刻，为兄我去一趟药铺。”
“张大哥。”
林砚一脸感动，心里却是明白过来，这张大海只怕一会随便拿一枚丹药回来忽悠自己。
张大海走了，还很贴心的将院门给关上。
“大人，您会不会刚刚摸错了，要不再摸一次？”
林砚一脸的不甘心，赵传轻哼一声：“本座岂会摸错，不过你既然不死心，那就上前再摸一次。”
赵传手掌搭在林砚身上，而这一次林砚却是第一时间感应脑海中的武道树。
在他的脑海中，武道树的灰枝此刻与绿枝分离，落在了绿树的一侧，成为独立的灰树，但高度却要比绿树矮了一截。
同时灰树枝干上也是长出了一片树叶，树叶之中有文字显露：莽牛桩。
就在刚刚，这一幕便已经在他脑海中出现过，且伴随出现的还有一道关于武道山的信息。
只要有人和自己身体接触，在没有防备情况下，灰色武道树可以感应出对方的武道境界，显露出对方最强的那一门功法。
灰树高度代表境界，叶子代表功法。
先前他就已经发现这位的武道树高度还没自己高，只是他怕自己感知错了，才让对方再摸一遍。
content_en:
It was still the dilapidated courtyard where Lin Yan traveled through time.
The martial artist who appeared in the teahouse was dressed in fine clothes and sitting on the top chair.
If you are still rational at this moment, you will find something wrong.
How could a majestic warrior appear in this dilapidated courtyard?
However, at this time, Lin Yan was playing the role of a young man who was hit by the good news of martial arts training, so naturally he would not point this out.
"Sir, these are the cakes I bought specially from Lan Kwai Fong. Please accept them."
Seeing Lin Yan open the paper bag, Zhao Chuan and Zhang Dahai looked at each other, with a trace of disdain in their eyes.
He is so stupid and naive that he still has the nerve to call him a smiler after a few packets of cakes.
But he is so stupid that he can be fooled.
"I'm determined."
Zhao Chuan picked up a piece of pastry and took a bite.
"Sir, how does it taste?"
Zhao Chuan was stunned. He was really stupid. Only when a superior or an elder gives pastries to a junior would he ask if the cakes are delicious. How dare you, a junior, ask?
However, Zhao Chuan still tasted it subconsciously and said lightly: "Not bad."
"Sir, Lin Yan wants to learn martial arts. Last time, I had to touch a bone. During this time, he has been using medicinal soup to recuperate his body's energy and blood. This time, he wants to become your master."
Zhang Dahai on the side couldn't hold it any longer. He didn't want to watch Lin Yan play tricks anymore and got down to business as soon as possible.
"Well, I have some impression of this matter. Please come forward and I will take a look at your bones."
Lin Yan stepped forward after hearing the words. Zhao Chuan's palm touched Lin Yan's body for a while, and when he let go, he sighed: "The energy and blood are much more abundant than last time, but there is still a long way to go before practicing martial arts. It's difficult."
"Ah, how could this happen?"
Lin Yan's face became anxious. When Zhang Dahai saw this, he quickly said: "Sir, Lin Yan is sincere. Can you see if there is anything you can do?"
"It's not that there are no methods. There is a pill called Blood Refining Pill, which can make up for the lack of Qi and blood after taking it. However, the price of this pill is not low. One pill costs thirty taels."
Good guy, I want not only my old house, but also the house where I and my aunt live now.
Thirty taels of pills, plus the money for the soups that he owed earlier, amounted to more than fifty taels.
Lin Yan had a panic expression on his face, and Zhang Dahai gritted his teeth: "Brother Lin has a martial arts training, I am willing to pay this money for him, I dare to ask, sir... Where can I buy this blood refining pill?"
"You can find it at any drugstore in the city."
Listening to these two people singing the double act here, Lin Yan was a little confused in his heart. He went to the drug store to buy it. The Chinese drug store in the city should not cooperate with these two people in acting.
"Brother Lin, please wait here for a moment while I go to the drug store for my brother's sake."
"Brother Zhang."
Lin Yan looked touched, but he understood in his heart that Zhang Dahai was just afraid that he would come back with a pill to fool him.
Zhang Dahai left and closed the courtyard door thoughtfully.
"Sir, did you touch it wrong just now? Do you want to touch it again?"
Lin Yan looked unwilling, and Zhao Chuan snorted: "How can I touch it wrong, but since you don't give up, then go forward and touch it again."
Zhao Chuan put his palm on Lin Yan, but this time Lin Yan sensed the martial arts tree in his mind for the first time.
In his mind, the gray branches of the martial arts tree were separated from the green branches at this moment, falling on the side of the green tree, becoming an independent gray tree, but the height was shorter than the green tree.
At the same time, a leaf also grew on the trunk of the ash tree branch, and there was a text in the leaf: Mang Niuzhuang.
Just now, this scene had appeared in his mind, and along with it there was a piece of information about Martial Arts Mountain.
As long as someone is in physical contact with him, without any precautions, the gray martial arts tree can sense the opponent's martial arts realm and reveal the opponent's strongest technique.
The height of the gray tree represents the realm, and the leaves represent the skills.
He had already discovered before that the height of this martial arts tree was not as high as his own, but he was afraid that his perception was wrong, so he asked the other person to touch it again.
